messages.subject: Announce: CREEM workshops 2004
parts:
Dear distance-sampling list,

We've just opened registration for our summer workshops here at St Andrews.
This year we're going to repeat the very successful workshop on estimating
animal abundance, as well as holding our regular workshops on distance sampling.
The distance sampling workshops were both over-subscribed last year, so early
registration is encouraged.

This is also a reminder that we're holding distance sampling workshops in Canada
this coming spring (on which there are still a few places available) and an
abbreviated workshop on estimating animal abundance in New Zealand in July.

For more information, see the web site below.

- Len Thomas
